name: project-ai-chat
description: From a public GitHub URL, upload, or paste, explain that project's skills and agents and suggest ideas the reader can adapt. Does not inspect a host tree.

inputs.name: user-message
inputs.description: Free-form chat. MAY include a project URL, attached or uploaded files, or pasted sources.

outputs.name: reply
outputs.description: User-visible markdown in the user's language.

outputs.name: guide-report
outputs.description: Structured catalog and adaptation ideas; empty when there is no usable evidence.
